thread:
maria: AM standup — quick notes

maria: Yesterday: landed kernel lock reduction patch for the batcher, ran microbench against 2k concurrent slots. p50 down ~8%, p95 steady. Deployed to canary-3.
Blocker: seeing noisy KV eviction during longer traces, occasional OOMs on the loader.
Today: expand canary to canary-4/5, try the eviction repro and add extra logging around kv::evict().

ash: Nice results on p50, congrats. Which tests showed the OOM? any stack traces?

maria: The OOMs show up only under sustained prefix caching + long-context traces. Minimal log snippet:
```
2026-03-16T09:12:03Z batcher: slot=1023 started seq=512
2026-03-16T09:12:04Z kv::cache: size=1.9GB limit=2.0GB
2026-03-16T09:12:04Z loader: allocate failed: Cannot allocate 256MB
2026-03-16T09:12:04Z evict: candidate=slot-998 reason=age success=false
```
Will add more traces to the canary.

samir: @maria I can try the repro locally. Do you have a small harness or a replay trace that triggers it? Otherwise I can simulate long-contexts + heavy prefix cache.

maria: Not yet a standalone harness — I'm extracting a replay now from canary-3. ETA ~1h. For quick experiments you can set `KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.75` in the env to be more eager; that mitigates in some runs.

priya: Ping on PR #4512 (kernel: batcher lock refactor) — CI formatting failing. Small style nit in batching.rs around the new guard impl. Will queue a fixup commit unless you want it, maria.

maria: please go ahead, priya, I want the CI green before wider rollout. Thanks.

jon: Quick FYI — perf dashboard for canary-3 updated: https://perf.redwood/canary-3/2026-03-16. Logs and trace links are on the dashboard (filter by tag `kernel-lock-reduce`).

ci-bot: CI: PR #4512 — build passed on linux-x86, failed lint on rustfmt.

samir: I'll start a local run with the evict threshold tweak and try to reproduce the failure. If I hit it, I'll attach a small repro and open an issue.

maria: awesome — if you reproduce, add `--trace-kv` to the run so we capture eviction candidates. Also maybe test with `BATCHER_SLOT_CAP=2048` to mimic canary load.

ash: If we need a temporary mitigation, we can add a circuit-breaker that rejects new warmup workloads when cache pressure > 0.9. Not ideal but safe.

maria: agreed — let's keep that as a hotpatch option. I'll leave canary-3 at current and only expand after we have repro/metrics.

priya: I'll push the rustfmt fix in a minute and tag the PR.

jon: Thanks all. Short follow-up: can we add a small note in the runbook about the `KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD` knob and the `--trace-kv` flag? saves time next time.

maria: Yup — I'll add a short section to the ops runbook after we confirm the repro.

samir: Logging off to run the local repro. Will report back here. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — tagging @samir for updates.

[thread end]
